arguments.query: select b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.status cs from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select b.*,c.* from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status!="confirmed"
select status,count(*) n from bookings group by 1 union all select "outbox_"||status,count(*) from outbox group by 1
select id,service,path,status,message from request_logs where status>=400 order by id desc limit 20

select "multi_charge" k,booking_id v from charges group by booking_id having count(*)>1 union all select "nohold",booking_id from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "nocheckin",booking_id from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "charge_state_"||state,count(*) from charges group by state union all select "cust_ev_"||event_type,count(*) from customer_events group by 1 union all select "cancelled_ck",booking_id from checkins where booking_id in (select booking_id from bookings where status="cancelled")
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
